description:
About the company
 Our client is a fast-growing artificial intelligence company.
 The role
 Raydar is recruiting for this role on behalf of our client. Work as a hands-on technical builder across engineering, product and research, owning work from design through production. The role combines writing and debugging production code with applied machine learning and model training, and suits someone who wants broad ownership over what they ship.
 What you'll do
 - Work directly with senior non-technical stakeholders to scope technical problems and turn them into deployable software systems.
 - Build and maintain internal toolkits and platform components that support customer deployments.
 - Train, fine-tune and evaluate machine learning models, including building test harnesses and simulated environments for reinforcement learning.
 - Study patterns and usage data from live systems to refine interfaces and abstractions.
 - Share technical findings and techniques across the team to keep the core platform current.
 Requirements 
 What we're looking for
 - Experience as a software engineer, machine learning engineer, forward deployed engineer or similar hands-on technical role, or a technical product manager who writes code.
 - Experience at a leading AI-native company or in a top research lab, or first-author publications at a major machine learning conference.
 - A history of substantial responsibility, such as building a product people actually use, being among a company's first hires, or running a product or client area from start to finish.
 - Takes full accountability for shipped software, including fixing problems that surface in live systems, with AI-assisted tooling welcome alongside real technical depth.
 - Prepared to spend workdays physically present at the team's New York base.
 Bonus points
 - Experience with post-training, reinforcement learning or model evaluation.
 - Experience shipping large language model or agent systems to production.
 - Degree from a widely recognized top school in computer science, electrical engineering or mathematics. Strong work experience can outweigh this.
 Benefits 
 Compensation and benefits
 - Base salary: USD 140,000 to 300,000 per year
 - Equity
 - Health insurance
 - Retirement plan
 - Flexible time off
 Location and work model
 - New York, NY, United States
 - On-site, 5 days per week
 - Full-time
